component-o.description-s: PCB through-hole 2-in-1 fuse holder for standard ATO/ATC blade fuses (and low-profile mini), black, UL 30 A @ 500 VAC, -50 to 145 C

source-o.table-s: 2 IN 1 FUSE HOLDER: for Littelfuse ATOF 287 series / Bussmann ATC series, Littelfuse Low Profile Mini (LP) series or equivalents; contacts 0.016 in brass, tin-nickel plate; insulator Nylon 46, UL 94V-0; UL current rating 30 A @ 500 V AC; UL temperature rating -50 to +145 C; CAT. NO. 3557-2 black, all colors UL rated for 30 A

not_stated-o.contact_mohm: Keystone's catalog page gives no contact resistance
not_stated-o.dc_rating: the UL rating is stated at 500 V AC only

component-o.pin_roles_note-s: pin roles: a fuse (and its holder) is non-polar; pin 1 = supply side (ds-power-rx) and pin 2 = load side (ds-power-tx) is a convention only, as on the DSK310 series diode; either orientation is electrically the same
component-o.supply_pins_are_pass_note-s: a fuse holder in the power path: its pins are the two contacts the blade fuse seats in, with no operating supply range of their own; the holder ratings in fuse_holder-o (UL 30 A @ 500 VAC) are the figures the checks use

provenance-o.basis-s: procurement public-check: every document in the record folder has a public http(s) source; nothing confidential, no correspondence or quote data, no person named outside non-technical-o, not an NDA part; footprint and 3D model of recorded public origin
